selection: Minimum sum of val/*_loss over epochs 1..300; first epoch wins ties.
keypoint_semantics: White wax block front lower-left and lower-right actual corners, ordered by image X. Not upper lip or tray corners.
checkpoint_format: Original full checkpoint; optimizer, EMA, scaler and original embedded training metadata retained without reserialization.
evaluation_note: Validation metrics are not independent final-test accuracy. The exact frozen training/validation images, labels and user-corrected previews are distributed under data/; final-test and gap images are excluded.
